controller: ZCode controller session (owner-directed dispatch, owner instruction 2026-10-05)
base_rationale: k6gate final tip = most complete VERIFIED 5-symbol evidence chain (contains six-gate 05e54939, six-adopt a4a88265, six-readiness 9fb66c88, ten-hypo 893db28c evidence trees). futures-behavior b583c33a (P3 quarantine round) is NOT an ancestor by design: P3 captures stay quarantined (owner D1 pending) and are never read.
interpretation_law: Owner instruction 2026-10-05 authorizes PREP + hypothesis research on all 5 symbols ONLY. It is NOT a typed GO, NOT cycle registration, NOT PB2/PB3 lift, NOT D8/D9 ratification, NOT any ceiling/cap signature, NOT fee-policy approval. Every prior open decision stays open; fail-closed defaults bind.
absolute_prohibitions: 0 scored runs / 0 backtest PnL / 0 strategy profit-loss trials (outcome-blind law)
0 dry-runs that compute strategy outcomes (record NOT_RUN + put in authorization packet instead)
no S1 access, no typed GO, no scored-cycle registration, no ledger/registry writes
no purchases, no accounts, no external messaging, no orders, no push, no merge, no history rewrite

no interference with the ES finalize cycle (worktree futures-es-reg / branch prep/futures-es-reg-20261004 is READ-ONLY evidence; extract files via 'git show prep/futures-es-reg-20261004:<path>' only, never write there)
no reads of P3-quarantined captures (futures-behavior 0225b3c2 content / P3 lane artifacts)
no bypass of transport restrictions; permitted calendar routes ONLY (WebFetch / web_reader / web.archive.org / plain curl), <=2 attempts/URL, blocked => BLOCKED_TRANSPORT
one heavy job machine-wide via canonical lock only; never kill foreign workers; never run parallel heavy jobs
no writes to ZCode internal databases; no credentials in prompts/logs/git
decision_namespace_law: All NEW decision/gate IDs minted in this round MUST be prefixed 'P5-' (e.g., P5-D1, P5-OD1). Prior decisions are cited by their full original IDs (ADOPT-D8/D9/D12, SIXGATE-OD-1..OD-7, BEHAV-D1..D7). Never renumber, never reuse a prior ID for a different question.
commit_law: Lanes never commit. Controller commits wave checkpoints by explicit pathspec (git add <paths>; 'git add -A' forbidden). Every claim of PASS must carry command + exit code + artifact path + SHA.
compute_discipline: Light single-shot reads of committed artifacts need no lock (record locks-inspect FREE before/after any job expected to exceed ~2 minutes). pytest suites on synthetic fixtures are light. Any full-panel rebuild or multi-minute scan must take the canonical heavy lock via research/researchctl.py and record it; if the lock is held => NOT_RUN_RESOURCE_CONFLICT, move on.
handoff_law: Every lane ends by writing dispatch/handoff_<LANE>.json, schema zcode_orch_v3_handoff@1 (fields: schema, task_id, cycle_id, role, lane, dispatch_sha, actual_start_sha, commit_sha=null, changed_paths[], tests[], authority_claims[], known_limitations[], incidents[], tree_status, workers, outputs[{path,sha256}], recommended_next_action). Chat prose is advisory; the artifact is authority.
